This information may also be disclosed by us to third parties on the IAB’s List of Downstream Participants that may further disclose it to other third parties.Personal Data Processing Opt OutsI want to opt-out of the Sharing of my personal data.Opted InI want to opt-out of the Sale of my Personal Data.OFFONOpted InI want to opt-out of processing my Personal Data for Targeted Advertising.OFFONOpted InCONFIRM Competitions 20 Mar 26 WIN: Tickets to Conan Gray at the 3Arena The Hot Press Newsdesk To be in with a chance of winning tickets, fill out the competition form below Conan Gray is set to bring his 2026 Wishbone World Tour to Dublin's 3Arena on Tuesday, May 5 – and we're giving you the chance to win a pair of tickets! The multi-platinum-selling singer-songwriter will be joined on the tour – which is in support of his acclaimed fourth album, Wishbone – by special guest Esha Tewari. Wishbone, which was executive produced by Grammy Award winner Dan Nigro, debuted at No.1 on Billboard’s Album Sales chart and No.3 on the Billboard 200 upon its release last August. The project follows 2020's Kid Krow, 2022's Superache, and 2024's Found Heaven – with Conan having clocked up over 12 billion global streams over the course of his remarkable career.
